senses.gloss: m. (preced.) force, unwillingness, necessity. על כרח־ (or בעל) against or without one’s will.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:22">Ab. IV, 22</cite> <he>על כָּרְחֲךָ וכ׳</he> without thy will thou hast been created &c.
<cite ref="Gittin 21a:10">Gitt. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>בעל כּוֹרְחָהּ</he> against her will, opp. <he>מדעתה</he>, v. <cite ref="D00950"><he>דַּעַת</he></cite>; a. fr.
